Fish larger than larval size (SWFSC Fish table): generally juveniles but not exclusively, counted per net and CalCOFI species code in addition to the larvae of the same net, never in both (Ed Weber, 2026-10-14, swfsc_ichthyo_20). Not in obs: no life stage in the vocabulary says exactly "larger than larval size".
The net (sample_type net) the fish were counted in; FK to sample.
CalCOFI species code (SWFSC SppCode); with sample_key the primary key. Its name is dataset_taxon.ds_scientific_name for ds_taxa_code = species_id.
The taxon the species code resolves to (by its WoRMS AphiaID); FK to taxon.

Raw count of fish larger than larval size in the sorted portion of the net (not standardized; see the net's std_haul_factor and prop_sorted in sample_measurement). Additive to the larval abundance of the same net and species code.

One row per SWFSC ichthyoplankton net with the two source columns the core projection drops: the net's side of a bongo pair and the tow's number at its station occupation, beside SWFSC's own NetId and TowId and the tow type. Join sample (sample_type = 'net', dataset_key = 'swfsc_ichthyo') USING (sample_key). What tells the two nets of a bongo tow, and two tows of one type at one occupation, apart; the SIO Pelagic Invertebrate Collection's Parent Net Event crosswalk matches on it.
The net's sample_key (swfsc_ichthyo:net:<NetId>); primary key and FK to sample.
SWFSC's NetId, the provider's identifier of the net (= sample.source_uuid of the net row).
SWFSC's TowId, the provider's identifier of the tow the net was on (= sample.source_uuid of the net's parent tow row).

Side of a bongo pair the net was on: S (starboard) or P (port) on CalBOBL (CB) and PairoVET (PV) tows; NULL on the single-net C1, CalVET (CV) and Manta (MT) tows. Zooplankton volume is measured on the starboard net only.
Which of several tows of one type at one station occupation this net's tow is (SWFSC TowNumber): 1 for all but 121 of 74,385 tows, up to 50. (site, tow type, tow number) is unique.
The tow's gear code (C1, CB, CV, MT, PV), as on sample.tow_type; see gear.csv.
